title: Implement a Move Constructor
learning_objective: Implement a noexcept move constructor that transfers heap ownership and leaves the source empty.
instructions: Add a noexcept move constructor to Buffer. Transfer data_ and set the source pointer to nullptr. Submit the complete Buffer class only; do not add main().
hints: Transfer other.data_ instead of allocating a replacement.
explanation: A move transfers ownership of the existing resource instead of duplicating it.
